reserveReview.rationale: Pinned Sonic block 80179059 on 2026-10-01: BrandedCustodian 0x54e14489646fd9693ea5071cb5dfeb1f5afa8f03 totalAssets() and USSD totalSupply() are exactly equal at 970622.051101100913413464 tokens. custodianTkn() returns 0x80eede496655fb9047dd39d9f418d5483ed600df, and brandedStablecoin() returns the tracked USSD contract. Frax's BrandedCustodian documentation describes 1:1 frxUSD backing. The direct reserve remains 100% Sonic frxUSD with a wrapper dependency on frxusd-frax; underlying Treasury and approved-stablecoin reserves remain inherited look-through exposure, not direct USSD slices.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Fixed-block Sonic frxUSD balanceOf the USSD BrandedCustodian reconciled to USSD totalSupply
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The direct reserve asset is fully identified as frxUSD. Asset-level reserve and custody risks beneath frxUSD remain inherited from the linked upstream record rather than repeated here.
